Joseph Dante Schwarz (born July 21, 2005) is an American-Dominican YouTuber, freestyler, and Twitch streamer. As of January 5th, 2026, he has over 467 followers, and over 73 subscribers. He is known (in his community) for trying to beat the Dark Souls series, and playing Jackbox, Terraria, and oftentimes Roblox.
=Career=
Streaming
Joseph started streaming in January 2024, in his dorm, when he was in the University of North Texas. After dropping out of university, in September 2024, he took streaming as a full-time job.
His old nickname, Immortal or Mortal, was from Mortal Kombat, since he enjoyed playing the game with his acquaintances, he was also called Pro.
Collaborations
Joseph collaborated with 2 significant streamers, which are:
* [https://www.twitch.tv/rasheam_ Rasheam]
* [https://www.twitch.tv/ne0n_sushi NE0N_Sushi].
